blockingFindings.title: R6 required finding fields are only partially tested
blockingFindings.issue: The R6 negative schema test removes only evidenceRefs and mappedRequirementIds. A schema or artifact helper could omit required fields such as findingId, summary, severity, category, linkedRequirementAmendmentProposalIds, confidence, shouldReimplement, reimplementationReason, or requiresUserDecision from the required contract and these tests would still pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local coverage that proves every R6 field is required, either by asserting the schema required list or by testing omission of each required finding field.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R6 requires every acceptance-review finding to include the listed fields, but the current tests do not exercise most of that requirement.
